photos.file: Many Grifola frondosa at the base of an oak tree.jpg
photos.desc: Many Grifola frondosa at the base of an oak
This image shows two fruiting bodies of Grifola frondosa . It was found at an about 150 year old oak, which was almost dead. The Mushroom was found in Bremervörde-Hesedorf at the Walkmühle.
